key.name: position
key.description: left: replace the notification list; right: add a column after the calendar.

key.name: player-above-notes
key.description: In the left position, show the GNOME media player above the notes instead of inside the notifications.

key.name: cover-size
key.summary: Cover size of the media player
key.description: default: 48 px as in GNOME; medium: 64 px; large: 80 px (scaled with the text).

key.name: single-player
key.description: Only the player that is playing (or was playing last) is shown above the notes.

key.name: rounded-cover
key.description: Cover art with GNOME's element corner radius (8 px).

key.name: show-progress
key.description: Show a seekable progress bar with elapsed and total time.

key.name: show-shuffle-repeat
key.description: Shown only for players that support them.

key.name: scroll-title
key.description: Scroll a title that does not fit instead of cutting it with an ellipsis.

key.name: player-menu
key.description: ⋯ button in the player header: open in Disquaire, show in Files, copy title and artist.

key.name: show-next
key.description: "Titre suivant : …" under the artist, for players that publish their queue (MPRIS TrackList).

key.name: ignored-players
key.description: MPRIS names (without org.mpris.MediaPlayer2. and the .instance suffix) never shown above the notes, nor by the Focus & Boutons player icon.

key.name: media-indicator
key.description: Equalizer bars at the far left of the Quick Settings icons while a player is playing or paused.

key.name: calendar-event-style
key.description: Calendar-coloured dot before each event, flat event card, past events dimmed, current event marked.

key.name: calendar-countdown
key.description: "in 25 min", "40 min left", "6 more days" (with a thin bar for multi-day events), "tomorrow"; refreshed every minute while the menu is open.

key.name: quick-event
key.description: + button next to the events title: create an event for the selected day without opening Calendar.

key.name: last-calendar
key.summary: Last calendar used for a quick event

key.name: hide-today-date
key.summary: Hide the date under the calendar

key.name: hidden-folders
key.description: Folders pinned in Grimoire that the column does not show.

key.name: selected-folder
key.description: Folder shown in the column. Empty: every visible pinned folder.

key.name: notes-collapsed
key.description: Shows only the header of the Notes column.

key.name: max-notes
key.description: Zero shows every note.

key.name: pinned-notes
key.description: Absolute paths of the notes kept at the top of their category.

key.name: note-colors
key.description: Absolute note path mapped to a colour name (blue, green, yellow, orange, red, purple).

key.name: new-note-shortcut
key.description: Opens the calendar menu with the new note field focused.
